gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. KH 3452/1, commencing at its junction with the existing Wai Chi Street, running in a north-easterly direction for about 100 m, then in a north-westerly direction for about 40 m and terminating at its junction with Pak Tin Street.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道之位置在KH 3452/1 號圖則內用黃色標明，起點與現時之偉智街連接，向東北伸展約一百米，再向西北伸展約四十米，在與白田街交界處終結。

history.submitter_remarks: Printed gazette ZH 偉志; corrected by G.N.3868 to 偉智.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured red on Drawing No. KH 3452/1, commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare mentioned above, running in a south-easterly direction for about 85 m, then in a south-westerly direction for about 68 m, and terminating at its junction with Wai Chi Street.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道之位置在KH 3452/1 號圖則內用紅色標明，起點與上述街道連接，向東南伸展約八十五米，再向西南伸展約六十八米，在與偉智街交界處終結。

history.submitter_remarks: Printed gazette ZH 偉志; corrected by G.N.3868 to 偉智.

remarks: G.N.3868 corrigendum (偉志→偉智) folded into this batch; no separate 3868 batch.
